reports.name: Personal income tax return
reports.description: Czech personal income tax return deadlines for the 2025 income year.

workflows.name: Prepare income tax return
workflows.description: Review income, deductible expenses, spouse credit, child tax credit, non-taxable deductions, and attachments before filing.

workflows.name: Submit income tax return
workflows.description: Submit the Czech personal income tax return by the paper, electronic, or tax-adviser deadline that applies.

workflows.name: Settle income tax balance
workflows.description: Pay the income tax balance by the applicable filing deadline when the return produces tax due.

events.title: 2025 paper income tax return deadline
events.description: Personal income tax returns for 2025 are due within the three-month statutory deadline when not using the electronic or adviser extension.

events.title: 2025 electronic income tax return deadline
events.description: The deadline is extended to four months after the taxable period when the return is submitted electronically.

events.title: 2025 adviser-filed income tax return deadline
events.description: The deadline is extended to six months after the taxable period when filed by a tax adviser or where audit conditions apply.

events.title: 2025 electronic income tax payment deadline
events.description: Income tax due with an electronically filed 2025 return is paid by the electronic filing deadline.
